briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026 (sources dated 2 to 15 November 2026)

## Regulatory

- Razorpay received its final Payment Service Provider licence from IFSCA to operate from GIFT City, following in-principle approval in April 2026. The licence covers moving money in and out of India under one regulatory framework (https://yourstory.com/2026/11/startup-news-and-updates-daily-roundup-november-02-2026; https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-gets-final-ifsca-licence-cross-border-payments-gift-city-126110200734_1.html).
- The licence could also support transfers by non-resident Indians to their families in India. It adds to Razorpay's existing RBI permissions for online, offline and cross-border payments (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/razorpay-gets-gift-city-licence-for-cross-border-payments/articleshow/135470766.cms).

## IPO

- SEBI issued final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November, clearing the next stages of listing (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).
- Reports put the issue at ₹5,000–6,000 crore with a target valuation of about $5 billion (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ipo-razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-5-000-6-000-crore-issue-eyes-5-billion-valuation/article-202997). Inc42 cites ₹6,000 crore (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo). ET cites ₹5,500–6,500 crore (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms). The figures differ across sources, so confirm before citing.
- ET reports a potential 2027 listing and says the company is exploring the raise amid valuation and profitability questions (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).

## Deals

- A wire report says a company agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The excerpt does not name Razorpay.** Do not attribute this deal to Razorpay until the link is verified.

## Hires and launches

- No hires or product launches within the window were found in the sources.

## Background (undated)

- Profile lists Bangalore HQ, B2B business model, and total funding of $834.43M across 12 rounds (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7). This is undated, so treat it as background only.

## Open questions

1. Does the Globex Corporation acquisition report apply to Razorpay, and if so, how does it affect the planned IPO timeline and the ~$5 billion valuation target?
2. Which final IPO size and valuation should we use (₹5,000–6,000 crore, ₹5,500–6,500 crore, or ₹6,000 crore), and what is the expected listing window given the 2027 target?
3. Following the GIFT City licence, what is the rollout plan for cross-border flows and NRI transfers, and which corridors or products come first?
